SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q6. A bag contains 3 red balls, 5 white balls, and 7 black balls. What is the probability that a ball drawn at random will be neither red nor black?
(a) 1/5
(b) 1/3
(c) 7/15
(d) 8/15

Answer / Solution:
Total balls = 3 + 5 + 7 = 15
Neither red nor black => white balls = 5
Probability = 5/15 = 1/3
Answer: (b) 1/3
